name: Ward 1
boundary_summary: MDC northern belt along the Chandigarh boundary, Saketri and the municipal eastern limit, returning along the MDC Sector 4/5 boundary and railway near Gandhi Colony. Locality summary of the final order dated 2025-12-30, not a cadastral boundary.

name: Ward 2
boundary_summary: MDC Sector 5 and the Sector 1/2/6 belt bounded by Manimajra, Command Hospital, sector dividing roads and the national highway. Sector 6 is indicated by the boundary narrative but omitted from the order's closing locality sentence. Consult drawing 17647/MCPKL dated 2025-12-09.

name: Ward 3
boundary_summary: Sectors 7 and 8, between the Chandigarh boundary and the dividing roads adjoining Sectors 5, 6, 9, 17 and 18. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 4
boundary_summary: Sectors 9 and 10 enclosed by dividing roads adjoining Sectors 8, 16, 15, 11 and 5. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 5
boundary_summary: Sector 15 bounded by Sector 10, Sector 16, the industrial area and Sector 14 dividing roads. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 6
boundary_summary: Sectors 16, 17 and 18 adjoining Chandigarh, Rajiv Colony and Indira Colony, with sector-road boundaries towards Sectors 7, 8, 9 and 15. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 7
boundary_summary: Rajiv Colony between the Chandigarh boundary, Sector 17 and the Indira Colony boundary through Labour Chowk. Ward inclusion does not establish colony regularization. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 8
boundary_summary: Indira Colony and Budhanpur between Rajiv Colony, Chandigarh, the industrial area and Sector 16. Ward inclusion does not establish colony regularization. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 9
boundary_summary: Sector 19 and the industrial belt adjoining Chandigarh and Punjab, separated from Ward 10 by the industrial-phase boundary and railway. Phase II follows the Hindi schedule and contemporary reporting; the English closing sentence says Phase I. Confirm the attached statutory drawing for individual plots.

name: Ward 10
boundary_summary: Sector 14, Abheypur, Aashiana flats and Industrial Area Phase I between sector dividing roads, railway, Punjab boundary and the national highway. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 11
boundary_summary: Sectors 12 and 12A with Rally and Railla, between Sector 14, Industrial Area Phase I, the national highway and the Sector 4/12 and 11/12 dividing roads. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 12
boundary_summary: Sector 5, Sector 11, Haripur and part of Sector 4. The Sector 4 internal B-road, market-back road and Haripur boundary separate this ward from Ward 13. Sector 4 is not wholly included. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 13
boundary_summary: Sector 3, Devi Nagar, a large part of Sector 4, a major part of Sector 21 and Krishi Colony. The Ghaggar bridges, national highway, Sector 4 internal roads and Maheshpur/Madrasi Colony edge define the described limits. Sectors 4 and 21 are split. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 14
boundary_summary: Maheshpur, Madrasi Colony, Fatehpur, part of Sector 21 and part of Sector 20, bounded by Ward 13, the national highway, Punjab and the internal line through Sector 20 towards the STP plot. Sectors 20 and 21 are split. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 15
boundary_summary: Part of Sector 20, Aashiana flats, Uperli Kundi and Nichli Kundi between the national highway, Punjab boundary and Ward 14's internal Sector 20 boundary near the STP plot. The English schedule spells Nichli Kundi as Nijhwali Kundi. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 16
boundary_summary: Chandimandir, Beed Ghaggar and part of Kharak Mangoli along the northern municipal limit, military boundaries and national highway. Kharak Mangoli is divided between Wards 16 and 17. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 17
boundary_summary: Part of Kharak Mangoli, Chowki, Naggal/Moginand, Jhuriwala, Nada and Sectors 23, 24, 25, 30 and 31. Described limits follow the Ghaggar, municipal/military edges and the Sector 25/26 dividing road. The English locality sentence separates Naggal and Moginand; the Hindi text groups their names. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 18
boundary_summary: Sectors 26, 27 and 28, Madanpur, Kishangarh, Tribune Mitra Vihar and ITBP Colony. Limits follow the Sector 25/26 road, Ghaggar/Punjab boundary, Ramgarh-Dera Bassi road, national highway and TBRL edge. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 19
boundary_summary: Ramgarh, TBRL Colony, Billa, Bhanu, Jaswantgarh, Mankya and Dabkori along the Punjab and outer municipal boundaries, with Ward 18 to the west and Ward 20 towards Kot. Source spellings include Bila, Manakya and Dabkauri. Final order dated 2025-12-30.

name: Ward 20
boundary_summary: Kot and the southeastern village belt through Mattawala, Khangesara, Sukhdarshanpur, Toka, Alipur, Naggal, Jalauli and Khatauli. The boundary begins at the Jalauli-Barwala municipal-limit junction and follows the outer municipal boundary and Ward 19. Barwala is a boundary reference, not an included village in the closing schedule. Final order dated 2025-12-30.
